name: Vernal-Bastion
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past frozen methane lakes, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
